title: Internal step of 215 mm
why: Above the 200 mm default but within the 230 mm exception, which needs a demonstration the spec cannot give.

steps.internal_step_height_mm.required: ≤ 200 mm, or ≤ 230 mm if it reduces the number of steps
steps.internal_step_height_mm.rationale: 4.2.2.11.2(2): 215 exceeds 200 but not 230; it is allowed only 'if it can be demonstrated' that it reduces the total number of steps by one. A person must decide.
